data.name: Dhyanika
data.gender_notes: Dhyanika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit words 'dhyana' meaning meditation and 'ika' meaning one. Dhyanika represents the focus and deep contemplation of one's thoughts towards spiritual growth and self-realization. The name Dhyanika carries the meaning “Meditation, Contemplation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhyanika usually hope their child will grow to embody meditation, contemplation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace inner peace and wisdom through meditation and self-reflection.
data.etymology: Dhyanika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meditation, Contemplation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhyanika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_sanskrit.name: ध्यानिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'ध्यान' (dhyana), which means 'meditation' or 'contemplation.' The suffix 'िका' (ika) is of Greek origin and means 'one.' Thus, 'Dhyanika' could be interpreted as 'one who contemplates' or 'one in meditation.'
